subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR wait for real embedded-agent proof of both the internal-handoff drop and sessions_send preservation paths before merge?
rationale: Repository policy makes real behavior proof a merge gate for external PRs, and the diff changes session-state prompt semantics that tests alone do not fully settle.

options.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run that shows stale internal handoff text is dropped while sessions_send content is preserved.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly own the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Coordinate with broader repair
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer the broader metadata-hidden orphan repair at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the single landing path.

recommendation.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run that shows stale internal handoff text is dropped while sessions_send content is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant and embedded-runner prompt repair boundary introduced in the earlier merged repair.
